curve left: left wheel 10 %, right wheel 40 %
curve right: left wheel 40 %, right wheel 10 %

control_flow: Forever: call avoidWalls, again and again.

avoidWalls: if the left light is below 30 %, then check the side obstacles (left: curve right; right: curve left; neither: call driveInTheDark); if the left light is 30 % or more, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left (10/40); otherwise curve right (40/10).
